items.issues: Irony ('equally agreeable names', 'done me the honour') clearly signals cool contempt; distractors each misread a detail.
'Confounded nuisance' + 'too stupid to be natural' map directly to B; A/C/D have no textual support (no crew lost, no relief, no admiration).
'Not the genteelest of fish' vs 'splendid', 'you'll like it, I know' make C clear; A/B partial misreads, D contradicted by recipe care.
Rhetorical questions might briefly tempt B/C, but 'work of the Eternal God' settles D.
C inverts who cannot swim (the narrator's party), a decent trap; 'very friendly indeed' makes A direct.
'Great bother', 'forced upon us' explicit; C/D borrow Washington details from the second paragraph as traps.
Archaic syntax ('abjuring thus his kingly seat', 'proper') raises reading load; final 'would you have her die?' secures C. Passage source context unclear but self-contained enough.
D is noticeably longer/more specific than A-C; otherwise direct ('I must speak to you before I die').
'Melancholy spectacle ... so lately the abode of mirth' spells out A; B lifts 'speedy peace' as a trap; D contradicted by 'gently'.
D is a real detail but a supporting analogy, not the purpose; A partial misread; C unsupported.
Cause-effect stated outright ('there could be but one result'); A contradicted by final drop; B/D unsupported.
A/B/C have essentially no textual hooks (no workers, no officials, no transmission talk); only D is viable.
'Live for her alone' immediately follows the peace; C inverts 'put aside ambition', B/D contradicted by decline.
Explicit ('now, it was never to be'); A/C/D recycle imagined-future details as traps. Very easy.
Near-paraphrase of 'being in a better condition to use it ... determined to hold fast'; B/D plausible but unsupported.
'Going is even worse than gone' gives D; C flips the intruder logic (text says detain intruders), good trap.
Requires linking 'zealous ... care of us' with 'no time to attend to himself'; D uses the 'confused' detail as a trap. Slight inference, still easy.
Twain-style deadpan; 'I had both' and the absurd plan make self-mockery unmistakable.
'Painful pause', 'stern and set' give C; D overstates (no grief/hopelessness yet), a reasonable near-miss distractor.
